name.en: Bratu sensitivity near the discrete fold

caption.ja: 離散fold近傍のBratu感度。実際の保存数値データの縮小図で、1次元問題です。
caption.en: Bratu sensitivity near the discrete fold. Preview from actual saved numerical data for a one-dimensional problem.

note.ja: ここでは−u″=λexp(u)の符号規約。Newton–Krylov法で残差・格子収束・内側線形解法の失敗を確認します。
note.en: The convention here is −u″=λ exp(u). Newton–Krylov checks cover residuals, refinement and inner-solver failures.

equation_note.ja: 内点31/63、離散fold anchorとの差.1/.01/.001。各状態は零初期値からの下枝。λの文字列を一度binary floatへ変換し、参照はその正確な値をDecimalで評価します。
equation_note.en: 31/63 interior nodes; gaps .1/.01/.001 below the discrete-fold anchor. Every state starts at zero on the lower branch. Parse each lambda string once to binary float; the Decimal oracle evaluates exactly that float.

name.en: Bratu sensitivity near the discrete fold

note.ja: 離散Bratuのfoldへ近づく6固定点で、状態誤差と線形許容差の影響を分け、独立shooting勾配と照合します。
note.en: At six fixed points approaching the discrete Bratu fold, separate state error from linear-solve tolerance and compare against independent shooting gradients.

title.ja: 離散fold近傍のBratu shooting・接線・随伴参照
title.en: Discrete Bratu shooting, tangent and adjoint references near a fold

references.formula: F_h=A_hu-\lambda e^u=0,\quad J_hs=e^u,\quad J_h^\top p=h u,\quad g=0.05\lambda+p^Te^u;\quad q^T(s_D-\widehat s)=p_D^T(r_s-r_D)+r_{pD}^T(s_D-\widehat s),\quad b=e^u,\ q=hu,\ r_s=b-J_h\widehat s,\ r_D=b-J_hs_D,\ r_{pD}=q-J_h^Tp_D.

assumptions.ja: 1D同次Dirichlet Bratu、内点31/63。検証する離散fold anchorの下.1/.01/.001に固定し、下枝状態を用います。λ文字列は一度binary64へ変換し、その正確な値を高精度参照へ渡します。
assumptions.en: One-dimensional Dirichlet Bratu with 31/63 interior nodes. Fixed gaps .1/.01/.001 below the discrete-fold anchor use lower-branch states. Each lambda string is converted once to binary64 and that exact value is passed to the high-precision reference.

note.ja: 連続foldは離散foldではありません。rtol1e-4/1e-8は達成必須、requested1e-12は観測のみで未達を収束と表示しません。返却候補の独立勾配精度は別判定。最小固有値/丸めscaleは浮動小数点の診断で保証区間ではありません。BratuのJは対称であり、非対称転置は別の演算子対照です。 inputsの/solver/gmres/retention_adaptationはR1/R2の履歴記述で、現状態解法は新契約の明示混合精度が上書きします。射影解の未達は別保存します。
note.en: The continuum fold is not the discrete fold. rtol1e-4/1e-8 targets are required; requested1e-12 is observational and unmet is never called converged. Independent accuracy of the returned gradient is a separate gate. Eigenvalue/roundoff scales are floating diagnostics, not certified intervals. Bratu J is symmetric; the nonsymmetric transpose is a separate operator control. The retained /solver/gmres/retention_adaptation text is historicalR1/R2;the newcontract explicitly overrides it for mixed-precisionSTATEsolves. ProjectedUNMET is separatelysaved.

reference_note.ja: 実行前凍結:独立67項目の参照資格後、共有32pytestと本群141固定判定。各候補の全入力・全許容差・失敗を保存します。実合否は同梱result/verificationを参照。 初回は32pytestと拡散59/近fold45判定後に内側残差未達で停止し保存。R2の一般Jv演算順は別96成分で資格済みですが、本試験の成功を意味しません。 R2本試験も保存済み未達。R3の状態専用hi+loは別20成分で資格済み、本3caseの合否は実result/verificationで確認します。 所有配列の全詳細はrecordsのlinear_memory内のfile/byteoffset/recordSHAからJSONLへ辿れ、本文には要約だけを表示します。
reference_note.en: Pre-run freeze:independent67-check reference qualification, then shared32pytest and141fixed group gates. Retain all inputs, tolerances and failures. Actual outcomes are recorded in the bundled result/verification. Initial attempt retained32passing tests and59diffusion/45fold gates before an unmet inner target. R2 general Jv association has separate96component checks; this does not imply primary success. R2 primary failure is also retained. R3 state-onlyhi+lo has separate20component checks;actual three-caseoutcomes are inresult/verification. Fullownership evidence is in the JSONL file/byteoffset/recordSHA referenced by each linear_memory summary;only compact summaries enter case metrics.

method_note.ja: 解析Jv、Poisson-Thomas右前処理、固定GMRES本体で接線と随伴を解きます。全rtol・最終候補・true residual・終了状態・丸めscaleを保存します。shootingと別の高精度Thomas-Newtonで離散参照を資格します。 R2は同じfloat64の隣接差を先に取る一般Jvで、元の非線形残差・GMRES・許容差は変更しません。 R3は状態Newton補正だけをhi+loで保持し、直接9積残差と3積状態更新を使います。物理状態はfloat64、感度/随伴GMRESは旧方式です。
method_note.en: Analytic Jv, Poisson-Thomas right preconditioning and the preserved GMRES body solve tangents/adjoints. Save every rtol, returned candidate, true residual, termination and roundoff scale. Qualify the discrete oracle through shooting and separate high-precision Thomas-Newton. R2 uses a general near-neighbor-difference association in binary64 Jv; the original nonlinear residual,GMRES and tolerances are unchanged. R3 expands only stateNewtoncorrections ashi+lo,direct9productresidual and3productstateupdate. Physicalstates stayfloat64;derivative/adjointGMRES staysordinary.
